mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 305, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 300 and UNRATE < 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment signal sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 101) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 101, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 1400) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1400, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS > 155000) signals robust economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 155000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 690000) indicates sustained economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 690000, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
